dcat_keyword_sm: A city that has affordable housing and is more liveable for all
dct_description_sm:
In addition to monitoring only greenfield lands, this report uses a mid-year to mid-year reporting period, from July 1, 2023, to June 30, 2024, and land supply as of July 1, 2024.
 
The full report can be found on Ottawa.ca.


Accuracy: Updates to polygons were based on the most recent parcel fabric at the time.

Update Frequency: As needed

Attributes:

PARCEL_1 = Parcel Number
TOT_UNIT_1 = Total Unit Potential
PARC_HA_1 = Parcel Size (ha)
SIN_UNIT_1 = Number of potential single-detached units
SIN_HA_1 = Potential area for single-detached dwellings (ha)
SEM_UNIT_1 = Number of potential semi-detached units
SEM_HA_1 = Potential area for semi-detached dwellings (ha)
TOW_UNIT_1 = Number of potential townhouse units
TOW_HA_1 = Potential area for townhouse dwellings (ha)
STA_UNIT_1 = Number of potential stacked townhouse units
STA_HA_1 = Potential area for stacked townhouse dwellings (ha)
APA_UNIT_1 = Number of potential apartment units
APA_HA_1 = Potential area for apartment dwellings (ha)
MIX_UNIT_1 = Number of potential mixed-use units
MIX_HA_1 = Potential area for mixed-use dwellings (ha)
STATUS_1 = Development Status

Contact: Maddie Harreman-Fernandes
